articles.title: A STEM-humanities faultline in IITs may have been exposed by Sahil death
articles.summary: Sahil Wakode’s death by suicide has sparked significant discussions about academic culture at IIT-B. The event has illustrated the divide between students in STEM and those in humanities.

Massachusetts restores cranberry bog to protect rare trout that moves between river and ocean
articles.summary: Massachusetts is restoring Century Bog, a former cranberry farm in Plymouth and Wareham, to complete protection of Red Brook from White Island Pond to Buttermilk Bay. The restored wetland and stream channel could benefit about 60 conservation-priority species, including “salter” brook trout that move between freshwater and saltwater estuaries..

Why is Finland asking Musk to help Ukraine prepare for winter war against Russia?
articles.summary: Russian ballistic missile strikes reached record levels this summer, putting further pressure on Ukraine's already limited air defence resources. Patriot systems are currently the only Ukrainian air defences capable of intercepting such missiles, but Kyiv's stocks of interceptor missiles are severely depleted.

articles.title: Divya files Rs 1 crore defamation suit against Bayilvan
articles.summary: Divya Sathyaraj initiated legal action against Bayilvan Ranganathan for making defamatory remarks following her YouTube interview. The Madras High Court has granted her interim protection and restrained Ranganathan from making further statements.
